reason: Original bounded review feedback is returned to the existing model/tool loop. Its next decision may retain successful evidence or stop; a review does not require re-executing modules.

changes.preserved: All prior nodes, source and Quality gates, original module execution, custody identity and strict body-consumption checks.
changes.receiptCompatibility: Older receipts remain unchanged; absent next-decision readback is a gap, never inferred adoption.

nonEffects: No runtime sequence or model adapter change
No mandatory new calls or module retries
No permission, source, risk or trading threshold change
verification: Original queued caller offline feedback input, next decision, and Quality failure gate readbacks
acceptance: Only actual feedback content influencing the following decision proves this handoff locally; offline substitutes do not establish natural LLM adoption.
